results.description:
They think they're obsessed but they have nothing on me.

My brother is missing. I have four men trying to take care of me. Danger lurks around every corner.

My older brother's best friends draw me deeper into their twisted world under the guise of protection from the secret threatening to tear my world apart.

Underneath their masks, it's all a lie. They want to own me, control me, and use me as their chew toy before they spit me out.

Dante loathes me.

Wyatt ignores me.

Drew dates me.

And Finn, he just wants me–all of me.

The truth is they all do. And I want them too.

Here's the thing: I'm not normal, and I'm never letting them go.

They think they're obsessed, but they haven't seen anything yet.

The Obsession series has 4 parts/books. It ends on a cliffhanger and continues Indecent Obsession.
